title: Tallystick
description: Research prototype for sports fact provenance, settlement replay and market-rule checks using synthetic data. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of the implementation and documentation, with the limitations stated in the repository.
notes: Apache-2.0 applies to original code and documentation. Original schemas and format definitions under spec/ are CC BY 4.0. Synthetic sports examples authenticate no real sporting event. Archival publication does not establish peer review, independent validation or production readiness.
